login.faceLater: After you sign in, you can turn on {method} so next time is one glance.
login.failSub: Hold your phone at eye level in good light and try again, or use your phone number.
login.lockedSub: Too many tries. Unlock your phone with your passcode, or sign in with your email and password.
login.signPhone: Sign in with my phone number
login.inviteLink: New here? I have an invite code
login.inviteSub: The office texted or emailed you a code when you were hired.
login.phoneNotLive: Phone sign-in isn’t switched on yet. Please sign in with your email for now.
login.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
login.setupSub: Turn on {method} and you’ll open VELORA with just a glance. No codes to type.
login.faceOffSub: Sign in once with your phone number or email, then you can turn on {method} for next time.
login.faceMissingTitle: {method} isn’t set up on this phone
login.faceMissingSub: Set it up in your phone’s Settings, or sign in another way.
login.faceSignedOutSub: For your security, {method} works again after you sign in with your phone number or email.
